title: JetBrains Releases Mellum2.1: A 12B MoE Open Model for Coding Agents
source_used: JetBrains blog (MarkTechPost blocked, HTTP 403); shattered.io for model-card figures
key_facts: JetBrains released Mellum2.1 on 8 Oct 2026, the next version of the 12B mixture-of-experts model it open-sourced in June.
Architecture unchanged: 2.5B active parameters, Apache 2.0 licence.
The change is post-training: reinforcement learning became the main stage, with millions of sandboxed runs across thousands of environments.
JetBrains says the model can explore a codebase, edit files and check its own changes.
Compared with Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma 4 E4B, JetBrains says it is the fastest under heavy load, serving almost twice as many tokens as Qwen3.5-9B.
Multi-token prediction makes single requests about 1.6 times faster; GGUF builds and the MTP head for vLLM are 'coming soon'.
shattered.io, citing the model card, reports 47.0% on SWE-bench Verified and much weaker results on the hardest agent benchmarks.
quote_evidence: Today, we’re releasing Mellum2.1, the next version of the 12B mixture-of-experts model we open-sourced in June.
Under heavy load, Mellum2.1 is the fastest model in the group and serves almost twice as many tokens as Qwen3.5-9B.
Mellum2.1 is available on Hugging Face.
why_it_matters_hint: A small open coding model that runs on a company's own hardware keeps code and data in-house.
notes: MarkTechPost (pool source) blocked; read JetBrains' own blog post, plus shattered.io for the 47.0% figure. Comparisons are JetBrains' own.
